findings.claim: Deprecation warning is silently skipped when both fields are set. The warning only fires `if (clientConfig?.strategy && !clientConfig.authStrategy)`.

Mutual-exclusion error mentions `authStrategy` even when the deprecated `strategy` field caused it. `authStrategy` here is resolved as `cfg.authStrategy ?? cfg.strategy`, so when a caller sets the deprecated `config.strategy` together with `accessKey`, the thrown message still says `config.authStrategy` and `config.accessKey` are mutually exclusive — misleading since the caller never touched `authStrategy`.
